Nina (Finance): Quick flag 52 customer 'orchid-labs' disputed invoice 3490; they say tokens look ~1.9M higher than their logs for Apr 18. Can platform confirm anything unusual?
Omar (Platform): window?
Nina (Finance): Apr 18 14:00-14:45 UTC. Our metering shows a spike starting 14:12.
Felix (Billing): that delta is about $114. Any recent pricing experiments?
pricing-bot: experiment 'dynamic-rate-test' enabled for 10% of traffic on 2026-04-18T13:55Z; rollout tag leaked to 22% for region=eu-west between 14:10-14:20 due to feature flag race. Billing multiplier applied incorrectly to some token events.
infra-oncall: confirmed flag flip on ff-service at 14:11; spike aligns with experiment window. We should either correct metering to use base-rate tokens or credit the customer.
Omar (Platform): technical fix: re-evaluate metered events for affected tenant with experiment multiplier removed. Recompute job ~60mins. Need finance sign-off to mutate billing rows.
Felix (Billing): provisional credit OK pending recompute, cap $120. Please attach audit CSV of affected events.
Nina (Finance): approved provisional credit and created BILL-ADJ-658. Please run recompute and post final token delta.
Omar (Platform): running replay now with idempotent keys. Will post results when done.
pricing-bot: incident INC-2026-498 opened for experiment rollout leak.
Nina (Finance): tagging customer ops to notify orchid-labs once we have final numbers. Thanks.
